       b)     Consideration of Bid #E-19-25 for ftirnishing Mid-Size SUVs and a Full-Size SUV
              for the City of Cheyenne. Solid Waste and Fleet Pool. (2023-2026 Optional 1%
              Sales Tax Fund and Solid Waste Fund)

Mr. Moody moved to accept the bid from Fremont Motor Company, Lander, Wyoming, in an
amount not to exceed $141,587.00, seconded by Mr. Esquibel. Motion carried by unanimous voice
vote.

Craig LaVoy, Public Works Deputy Director, provided a staff report.

       c)     Consideration of Bid #E-20-25 for furnishing five (5) new Snow Plows for the City
              of Cheyenne, Street & Alley Division. (20 19-2022 Optional 1% Sales Tax Fund)

Mr. Moody moved to accept the bid from Fremont Amen-Tech Equipment Co., Evansville,
Wyoming, in an amount not to exceed $216,887.50, seconded by Mr. Esquibel. Motion carried
by unanimous voice vote.

Craig LaVoy, Public Works Deputy Director, provided a staff report and Ti Barttelbort,
Purchasing M anager, provided additional infonnation. Committee member Roybal commented
on the item.
